chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Niebaur's band declines: Beanie marries and Bill drinks
summary: Beanie Niebaur leaves for the Chicago Theater and marries an acrobatic dancer from the Detroit act while brother Bill takes to drink.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Okay but anyway, the point is that you were doing your own thing in Chicago and all these other fellows - the Austin High School people, Jimmy McPartland and all those guys, they were doing their thing - Art Hodes was around then too ---
But, you - in the next couple of years - then you gradually became acquainted and heard most of these fellows - didn't you?
Well, I started to work around where
these guys were too - you know. What happened with the band - ---Beany Niebaur got married; Bill was a terrible drunk---
You pronounce it Neiber but it's really Niebaur--- - you told me that--
But, you keep calling him Neiber anyway.

Yeah - well, Niebaur---- . It's been a long time since I've used his name--- but, Beanie got married and he had a chance to go to the Chicago Theater, which was a hell of a job in Chicago. You know, where they had the symphony as well there - the Chicago Symphony Orchestra. I mean, the Chicago Theater Symphony Orchestra. And, he was a marvelous player; he married a girl named - an acrobatic dancer named Caroline LaRue---
Well, she was in the Detroit act wasn't she?
Yes, that's where he met her.
I got poor old (inaudible) Sanders trying to find her---
Oh, Lord - she has been dead for years, I'm sure.
